title: Spay
summary: SPAY, verb transitive [Latin spado, a gelding.] To castrate the female of a beast by cutting and by taking out the uterus; as, to spay a sow.

inlines.v: SPAY, verb transitive [Latin spado, a gelding.] To castrate the female of a beast by cutting and by taking out the uterus; as, to spay a sow.
